node: # Lane governance-account, wave 41, 2026-09-14. No browser, no dev server and no screenshot loop was run (wave rule), so
# column 3 is `-` on every line: each verdict is the component source resolved against node data read live this run with
# get_design_context / get_metadata. New file - this section had no vverify sheet before. Append below; keep carried rows.

note: Proposals table header at 1440. The frame's `Frame 1` is 1254 wide inside a 1318 table at a 32px left inset, columns Status 120, Short code 100 at x=120.97, Proposal name 500 at x=221.94 (77 text + a 16px glyph at 79), Category 150 at x=722.92, Creation date 200 at x=873.89, Action 179.14 at x=1074.86, every heading 16 tall. ProposalsTable.tsx ships that exact colgroup (120/100/auto/150/200/179) with a 12/16 head and a 32px pl/pr, so this header needed no change this pass.

All-proposals header at 1440 after 257e4273c. Heading Manrope Regular 24/28 at -4% (5371:64397), then a right group on a 24px gap: the 140-wide scope control with a 1px #123F3C border at radius 8, px16 py8, label 14/18 -4% and a 16px chevron justified right (5371:64408), then the 158x36 Sky Blue `Create proposal` at radius 8, px40 py1.5, a 24px glyph 2px from a 14/18 -4% #001615 label (5373:69129). Built to those numbers.

Proposal-history header at 1440 after 257e4273c. Same heading cut, and the same 140x34 "Relevant" control (5371:64950) the open list carries - the history section had no control at all before this pass. No CTA on this header, and none was added.

Financials Overview tile row at 1440 after 5ffe195b0. Built: tile 8px radius on #001615, p16, label Manrope 14/18 -4% white at 64% opacity, 12px to a Mulish 22/26 -4% value carrying its unit, 6px to a Mulish 12/16 -4% #95A09F caption; all four captions take the frame's wording. Remains: the frame draws no glyph beside the label and this build keeps one inline (same row, so the tile geometry is unaffected), and the tiles sit 2x2 at 375 where the frame's own 375 board was not re-read this pass.

Financials `Pending treasury impact` empty panel at 1440 after 5ffe195b0. 300 tall, bg rgba(18,37,36,.44), radius 12, px16 py24; headline Manrope 18/24 -4% white over a 4px gap to a 214-wide centred Mulish 12/16 -4% #95A09F sentence, then 24px to a 161x34 Sky Blue CTA at radius 8, px40 py8, label then a 16px glyph on a 4px gap. Copy matches the frame word for word.

Financials `Treasury spend` empty panel at 1440 after 5ffe195b0. Same 300-tall panel as 5387-77766 with the frame's own wording - "No recorded treasury spend" over "There are no treasury spends recorded in this DAO yet". The component had been writing "No treasury spends recorded yet" in a small EmptyState inside a p-5 card.

Delegation Overview card at 1440 after 86534a546. Built: the single-word `Overview` heading at 18/24 (5385:74517), the `Total: n SKAI` chip in the frame's order and unit (5385:74523/74524, 12/16), and both tiles sentence-cased with the power figure carrying SKAI. Remains: the frame's `Your power` VALUE is a vote count ("5 votes", 5385:74537) with the SKAI figure demoted to the caption row, and SKAIGovernor exposes no per-wallet vote count to render it from.

Delegation `Delegates` table at 1440. Measured in full - S/N 120, User 500 at x=120.97 with a 24px avatar and the handle at a 30px offset, Voting power 100 at x=621.94 with a 16px glyph, 7D change 150 at x=722.92, Number of delegators 200 at x=873.89, Action 179.14 at x=1074.86, rows 46 tall with a 90x30 CTA and a 16px kebab; the header above it carries a 200x34 `Search delegates` field and two 140x34 selects on a 496 row at x=822. NOTHING in src renders it: there is no delegate registry, no per-delegate voting-power read and no 7-day power series, so every column but S/N would have to be invented.

Earn opportunities table at 1440. Measured: 1318 wide, header 28 tall on a 1254 row at a 32 inset, Pool 220 / Fee 100 / APY 100 with a 16px info glyph / TVL 162.48 with a glyph / Risk 162.48 / Volume (1W) 162.48 / My position 162.48 / Action 179.14, rows 50 tall whose first cell is a 44x24 pair of overlapping 24px coin circles then the name. src/pages/defi/Earn.tsx renders a stack of Cards instead, so the table exists nowhere; the two columns with no current source are Fee and Volume (1W).

Governance About copy block at 1440 after 3b53f52ef. The frame's node is a pre-wrap block of TWO 18-leading paragraphs with a blank line between them, the whole block at 64% opacity, under a 24/28 -4% heading with a 16px glyph 8px to its left. It had been shipping as one unbroken run at full strength; both are now as drawn.

Governance About `Skai network` link row at 1440 after 3b53f52ef. 80 tall on #122524 at radius 12, p16, a 24px glyph 8px from a text column whose title and description sit 8px apart at 14/18, the description at 64% opacity, and a 16px chevron on the right edge. The description had been rendering at the same strength as the title.

Staking vault-overview caption at 1440 after 3b53f52ef. The frame writes the APPROXIMATION sign under the vault balance, not an equals - the balance is the basis for voting power, not the power, and they diverge the moment any of it is locked in an open vote. Fixed. The `All time` timeframe select (11314:138141) and the cross-chain `Deposit from token: Solana / SOL` panel remain unbuilt, both for want of a source.

Gauge table header at 1440 after d96b99c69. Built: `Pair` and `Contract` as their own columns (they had been stacked in one cell) and the share column renamed `Votes`, every heading Manrope Regular 14/18 at -4%. NOT built: the frame's fourth column `Caps` (100 wide) - GaugeRow carries no per-gauge vote cap and the controller exposes no read for one.

Yield vaults page title at 1440 after e0c0c3227. Manrope Light 32/36 at -4% in sentence case, 8px above a 16/22 -4% #95A09F standfirst. It had been a 24px semibold heading over 14px body. The standfirst keeps sUSD where the frame writes sUSDC: the token supersedes sUSDC and is not a bridged asset.

Airdrop claim panel wallet row at 1440 after 33ba6bc7f. The frame names the wallet the claim will pay - `Your wallet:` at 14/18 then the truncated address. The page had shown the address only on the NOT-eligible branch, so an eligible holder with several wallets connected could not tell which one the allocation belonged to before signing.

Airdrop `Token overveiw` Price tile at 1440. The frame prints $0.05542. SKAI is unlaunched (Casey, 2026-08-13), the chain registry holds only BTC-USD and ETH-USD and skai_getMarketStats("SKAI-USD") answers `market not found`, so there is no live price to read. If this tile is ever built it renders the unavailable glyph, never the figure drawn. Recorded so the number is not copied out of the frame.

Account overview title row at 1440 after 72c6ec71d. Read live: a 24px icons/action at x=0 with the title at x=34, Manrope LIGHT 32/36 at -4% in Core/White - the same cut and ladder Account.tsx already carries for "Account settings" off the sibling boards (20/24 at 375, 24/28 at 768). The right cluster is two 140x34 bordered controls 8 apart (#123F3C border, radius 8, px 16 py 8, Manrope Regular 14/18) then a 36x36 Sky Blue 300 button 8 further on. Built: the title and the period control match. The "Trade" dropdown and the 36px button are deliberately absent - neither has a destination on an account surface, which is the same call AccountOverviewCard recorded against the same "Trade" control on 5518:102068.

Account overview stat row at 1440 after 72c6ec71d. Read live: four equal cards in a 1202 row, 16 apart, 113 tall - Green Coal 200 #122524, radius 16 (Figma rounded-2xl, which is 16px here and NOT this repo's rounded-2xl), padding 16, shadow 0 10 80 rgba(0,0,0,.25), each a column that pins its label to the top and its figure block to the bottom. Label Manrope Regular 14/18 at -4% Core/White; figure Mulish LIGHT 32/38 at -4%, white on three cards and App/Green 300 #17F9B4 on Profit factor; the volume delta Mulish Regular 14/18 at -4% in #17F9B4, 4 below the figure. The "24H" control on the Win rate card is opacity 0 in the frame and is not drawn. PerformanceOverview.tsx ships those exact values.

Account overview stat row at 375 after 72c6ec71d. Read live and it is a different card, not a scaled one: two rows of two, 8 apart in both axes, cards 167.5 wide and 90 tall at padding 12 and radius 12 (Figma rounded-xl), same fill and shadow. Label Manrope Regular 12/14 at -4%; figure Mulish Light 20/24 at -4%; delta Mulish Regular 12/14 at -4% in #17F9B4. This board is what pins the small end of the ladder - the 768 rungs between it and 5525-11349 are derived from measured glyph widths, not read, and the status row says so.

Best trade / Worst trade pair at 1440 after 72c6ec71d. Read live: two equal cards 16 apart, Green Coal 200 #122524 at radius 8 (Figma rounded-lg) and padding 16, a 12 gap between the two lines. Label Manrope Regular 14/18 at -4% in Core/White at 64% OPACITY - not a muted token, the white one dimmed. Figure Mulish REGULAR 22/26 at -4%, App/Green 300 #17F9B4 on best and App/Red 300 #FF574A on worst. Both figures are signed in the frame, which formatCurrency does not do for positives, so the build signs them.

Lane earn-detail, wave 42, 2026-09-14. Appended. No browser and no build (wave rule), so column 3 stays `-`: each verdict is the new page source resolved against node data read live this run with get_design_context / get_screenshot.

Other opportunities table header at 1440: eight columns, Pool / Fee / APY / TVL / Risk / Volume (1W) / My position / Action, in that order. DETAIL_TABLE_COLUMNS carries the same eight in the same order and the oracle at src/pages/earn/__tests__/opportunityDetailBoard.figma.test.ts pins it. Body split measured 870 chart + 432 figure card on a 16px gap; the page uses lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_432px] gap-4.
The same table at 768 drops Volume (1W) and My position and keeps six columns. DETAIL_TABLE_FROM_1440 = hidden lg:table-cell carries exactly those two, so 768 renders six.

The same table at 375 keeps Pool, APY, TVL and the row control only - Fee, Risk, Volume (1W), My position and the Action button are all absent. DETAIL_TABLE_FROM_768 carries Fee, Risk and Action; DETAIL_TABLE_FROM_1440 the other two. No cell hinges on sm: (640), which is not a board.

The lending board changes three strings together: the tab reads Total market value, the headline Total lended (TVL), the CTA Lend. detailValueTabLabel, DETAIL_TVL_HEADLINE.lending and DETAIL_VERB.lending are those three and nothing else moves.
The save board reads Total value saved (TVL) over a Save CTA; DETAIL_TVL_HEADLINE.vault and DETAIL_VERB.vault match.

Update position at 1440: the figure card is headed My position value with the period yield beside the amount, and the CTA row splits into an outline Withdraw plus the primary verb. Built, and pinned by OpportunityDetail.figma.test.tsx. The held amount keeps its own asset unit rather than the frame's dollar figure - recorded divergence, not a miss.

Ways to earn ticket, 1440: six rows led by Buy tickets on the accented row, then Vault balance, Faucet claims, Hi-Lo gaming, Streak bonus, Referrals, every name sentence case. ENTRY_SOURCES is now that order and that casing; the panel heading and the purchase card read Ways to earn ticket and Buy lottery ticket as drawn.

Sample vault item at 1440: the stats panel is headed Vault overview over TVL, APY range, Share price, Shares outstanding, Active deposits, Available liquidity, Pending withdrawals - seven rows, that order, which YieldVaultDetail already carried and now heads correctly. Subline reads <symbol>, USD denominated with a SKAI Chain chip.

node: # Lane governance-handoffs, wave 42, 2026-09-14. Appended below wave 41's rows; nothing above was edited. No browser
# and no build ran, so column 3 is `-` on every line: each verdict is component source resolved against node data read
# live this run with get_design_context / get_metadata on 3sSzw1KewMtUbeLAv7uW0r.

note: Gauge voting overview panel at 1440, read live. Frame: #122524 card, 16px inset, 24px top radius over 8px bottom, shadow 0 10px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25); Manrope Regular 18/24 -4% heading 24px above a 2x2 grid at an 8px gutter; tiles #001615 on an 8px radius at 10px padding, centred, label Mulish Regular 12/16 -4% #95A09F over value Mulish Regular 22/26 -4% white, `Voting ends in` value #17F9B4. VotingPowerDisplay.tsx now ships exactly that, with the frame's four labels (`Staked SKAI`, `Epoch`, `Voting ends in`, `Weekly emissions (SKAI)`). Commit 910be4e5a.

Bribe rewards panel at 1440, read live. Heading, standfirst, card radii and the claim row's geometry match after 910be4e5a (#001615 row on a 12px radius at 12px padding, 36px mark, amount Mulish 14/16 white beside symbol Manrope Bold 14/16 #95A09F, delta Mulish 11/14). The one gap is the claim affordance: the frame draws a single 335x42 card-level CTA at 5515:96221, and bribeVaultService exposes only claimBribes(epochId, gauge) with no batch entrypoint, so the per-row control stays and this is not a whole-frame match.

Insurance fund card at 1440, read live. Frame: #122524 on a 16px radius at a 16px inset, 24px between blocks; header a 34px white tile (8px radius, 1px #123F3C) 8px from Mulish 14/18 -4% over Mulish 11/14 at 64%, state word at the far end in Manrope Bold 14/18 #95A09F; four stats as two even rows 12px apart, label Mulish 14/18 #95A09F over value Mulish 14/18 white at a 4px gap; coverage block BELOW the stats at a 10px gap, then an 8px bar on a 6px radius, track #123F3C, fill #56C7F3. InsuranceFundHealth.tsx now ships that order and that ramp. Commit 24e3efd2b.

Vault card on the Yield vaults board at 1440, read from the board's metadata. Frame: 395.33x248 with a 16px inset; header 34 tall — a 32px chip, name 18-tall over symbol 14-tall at y=20, product word right-aligned at y=8; rule at y=46; stats at y=58 and y=110, two even 40-tall rows; CTA at y=174, full width, 42 tall. VaultCard.tsx already draws that (chip p-1 + a 24px glyph = 32, name Mulish 14/18 over symbol 11/14 at 64%, product word Manrope Bold 14/18, gap-3 inside and gap-6 to the CTA), so it needed no change this pass.

The collective card, right half of Frame 604 on the Proposals board at 1440, read live. Frame: #0F3451, 32px padding, contents centred, a 475 measure, headline Manrope Regular 24/28 -4% white 13px above a paragraph at Manrope Regular 14/18 -4% white at 64%, band shadow 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.24). GovernancePageHead.tsx now ships that, including the paragraph 5371:64391 the card had never drawn. The card is a match; the band's LEFT half is not — see the status row's Casey decision. Commit 5c3ea08b4.

Delegates table at 1440, read live. The head is built to the frame — 32px inset, 6px above and below, cells Manrope Regular 12/16 -4% #95A09F, widths S/N 120, User 500, Voting power 100, 7D change 150 centred, Number of delegators 200, Action 179.14 right, closed by a 1px rule. NO ROWS EXIST TO DRAW: no delegate registry, no per-delegate power read, no delegator count and no seven-day series, so the body is the explicit unavailable state and the per-row Delegate/Remove controls are absent. Not a defect in the frame and not an empty list — the source does not exist. Commit fcd96c2ec.

Off-chain delegation card at 1440, read live. Geometry, copy and type are built to the frame (#03383E, 32px padding, 8px top-right over 24px bottom-right, title Manrope Regular 24/28 -4%, paragraph 16/22 at 64%, `Wallet address` label 8px above a #001615 field on a 16px radius with a 1px #123F3C border and 22/16 padding, placeholder `0x ...`, DELEGATE in #56C7F3). The field is INERT: partial and expiring delegation needs a share and an expiry, snapshotService writes none and delegateVote takes an address only, so wiring it would silently delegate full power with no expiry. Commit fcd96c2ec.

Airdrop snapshot table head at 1440, read live. Frame: 28 tall, the cell row inset 32 and 6 from the top, Rank 120, User 362, Points accumulated 100, Reward 150, Wallet address 200, Decision 179.14, closed by a 1px rule at y=28. AirdropSnapshotList.tsx ships that head verbatim. The body has no source and draws the unavailable state; the head itself is a match. Commit a4dee9d2b.

The Airdrop board's `Price $0.05542` tile. SKAI is unlaunched, the chain registry holds no SKAI-USD market and there is no listing, so the figure the frame draws cannot be sourced at any time. It is built nowhere as a number and must always render the unavailable glyph. Recorded, not built.

Account dropdown-3 at 1440 — RE-KEYED FROM partial, on work that landed at HEAD after wave 43 measured it. f1a74eac1 (2026-09-14 22:40, an hour after that reading) adds the frame's Portfolio row on a briefcase under Account and its How it works row on the external-link glyph, which were two of wave 43's three reasons for holding it. The third, that the build draws rows the frame does not, is not a gap: AccountDropdown.tsx:476 records the standing rule that a working destination a frame leaves out is kept, and Casey's 2026-09-14 ruling 'match figma' (report 50a2c1f6) was executed as adding what was missing rather than deleting what was extra. Geometry re-resolved against the source and unchanged: panel 250 at md and 200 below it, p-2 with gap-2, items px-2 py-1.5 on a 4px corner at 14/18 = 30 tall on a 38 pitch, a 16px mark at x=8 with its label at x=32 via mr-2, and [role=separator]:my-0 for the frame's 0-tall rule inside the column gap. No browser: source-vs-node.
